title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 4,051–4,100 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 電影製作人；導演；電影人

examples.en: Legendary Taiwanese filmmakers Ang Lee and Hou Hsiao-hsien won global acclaim.
examples.zh: 享譽國際的台灣傳奇電影大師李安與侯孝賢榮獲坎城與威尼斯影展最高榮譽。

examples.en: The young independent filmmaker secured funding through a grassroots crowdfunding campaign.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的獨立電影製作人透過群眾募資平台，成功為處女作籌得關鍵拍片資金。

examples.en: Documentaries allow a dedicated filmmaker to shine light on marginalized communities.
examples.zh: 拍攝紀實紀錄片讓熱血電影人得以將鏡頭對準並照亮被社會大眾忽略的弱勢邊緣群體。

words.definition: 電影劇本；劇作腳本

examples.en: The original screenplay earned the prestigious Golden Horse Award for Best Writing.
examples.zh: 這部深刻描繪台灣在地家庭情感的原創電影劇本榮獲金馬獎最佳原著劇本大獎。

examples.en: Adapting a complex seven-hundred-page historical novel into a tight two-hour screenplay took two years.
examples.zh: 將厚達七百頁的複雜歷史長篇小說改編為兩小時精煉電影劇本，耗費了編劇整整兩年心血。

examples.en: The screenwriter revised the dialogue in the screenplay to enhance natural pacing and comedic timing.
examples.zh: 編劇反覆推敲修改劇本中的角色台詞，以提升整場對白的生活節奏感與幽默喜感。

words.definition: 電影攝影美學；電影攝影術

examples.en: Breathtaking natural lighting cinematography captured the misty mountain vistas.
examples.zh: 巧奪天工、全然採用天然光線的電影攝影美學，將台灣群山雲霧繚繞的意境完美凝結於銀幕。

examples.en: The film won several awards for its innovative cinematography and dynamic camera movements.
examples.zh: 該片憑藉開創性的電影攝影美學與動態流暢的運鏡調度，橫掃多項國際大獎。

examples.en: Masterful cinematography uses shadow, color palettes, and perspective to build emotional depth.
examples.zh: 精湛入微的電影攝影巧妙運用光影明暗、色彩基調與透視構圖，建構出深邃的角色情感。

words.definition: 電影製片人；監製；製作人

examples.en: The executive producer secured international distribution rights across global streaming platforms.
examples.zh: 執行製片人（監製）成功爭取到了在各大全球主流線上串流影音平台的國際獨家發行權。

examples.en: The line producer manages daily production logistics, keeping the shoot strictly on schedule and within budget.
examples.zh: 統籌製片嚴格把關片場每日拍片後勤與開銷，確保拍攝進度分秒不差且絕不超支預算。

examples.en: A visionary film producer knows how to assemble the right creative talents to bring stories to life.
examples.zh: 一位具備遠見卓識的電影製片人懂得精準集結最適切的幕前幕後創作人才，賦予劇本靈魂。

words.definition: 演員試鏡；參加試鏡遴選

examples.en: Over five hundred aspiring actors attended open auditions for the teenage role.
examples.zh: 超過五百位懷抱演藝夢想的青年演員積極參加了這部青春校園熱血電影的公開主角試鏡。

examples.en: She felt nervous before her Broadway musical audition, but her vocal performance brought goosebumps.
examples.zh: 在百老匯音樂劇試鏡開始前她手心直冒冷汗，但一開口驚艷絕倫的高音唱腔震撼全場評委。

examples.en: He was invited to audition for the role of the enigmatic detective after the director saw his indie short.
examples.zh: 導演在看過他在獨立短片中的亮眼表現後，主動邀請他前來參加神秘偵探一角的試鏡。

words.definition: 全體演員陣容；合奏的

examples.en: The movie boasts a stellar ensemble cast featuring veteran award-winning actors.
examples.zh: 這部年度賀歲大片匯聚了全體鍍金的豪華全體演員陣容，演技派巨星同台飆戲火花四射。

examples.en: Outstanding ensemble chemistry allowed the cast to improvise witty banter effortlessly.
examples.zh: 演員群之間絕佳默契的化學反應，讓全體卡司在對戲時能信手拈來碰撞出爆笑火花。

examples.en: The chamber orchestra ensemble performed classical pieces with breathtaking synchronization.
examples.zh: 這支室內樂合奏室內樂團以分毫不差、令人屏息的絕佳默契演奏了多首世界古典名曲。

words.definition: 配角的；支持輔助的

examples.en: She delivered a tear-jerking performance, winning Best Supporting Actress honors.
examples.zh: 她在片中飾演慈祥堅毅的母親，交出了一段令人動容落淚的精湛演技，實至名歸勇奪最佳女配角。

examples.en: A nuanced supporting character often provides vital comedic relief or moral contrast in dramatic films.
examples.zh: 刻劃立體細膩的配角往往能為深沉肅穆的劇情片帶來畫龍點睛的笑料緩衝或強烈道德對比。

examples.en: He earned widespread critical acclaim for his memorable supporting performance as the loyal butler.
examples.zh: 他在片中飾演忠心耿耿的家族老管家，搶眼難忘的綠葉配角演技贏得了影評界一致盛讚。

words.definition: 名人驚喜客串演出；浮雕首飾

examples.en: The famous pop singer made a humorous two-minute cameo appearance as a barista.
examples.zh: 超人氣金曲歌王在電影中驚喜客串演出了兩分鐘幽默風趣的咖啡店吧檯咖啡師。

examples.en: Comic book creator Stan Lee was famous for his delightful cameo appearances in Marvel blockbuster films.
examples.zh: 漫威之父史丹李以在各大超級英雄漫威大片中驚喜客串亮相彩蛋而深受全球影迷津津樂道。

examples.en: She wore a delicate antique cameo brooch pinned to the lapel of her tailored wool coat.
examples.zh: 她在合身羊毛大衣翻領上別了一枚雕工精細入微的古董浮雕貝殼胸針，盡顯高雅品味。

words.definition: 分鏡腳本；故事板圖稿

examples.en: Animators sketched detailed storyboards to plan complex superhero action sequences.
examples.zh: 動畫師與動作指導精心繪製出上百張詳盡的分鏡腳本，以預先規劃複雜的超能力打鬥運鏡。

examples.en: Reviewing the illustrated storyboard helps the entire crew visualize camera angles and lighting setups.
examples.zh: 逐格檢視圖文並茂的分鏡腳本圖稿，能幫助全體劇組直觀預視攝影鏡位與燈光打光佈局。

examples.en: The director pinned dynamic storyboard sketches onto the studio production wall to brief the camera operators.
examples.zh: 導演將動態分鏡草圖一張張釘在攝影棚會議室牆面上，向全體攝影團隊詳細解說運鏡軌跡。

words.definition: 拍片勘景；物色場地；童軍活動

examples.en: The crew spent two months location scouting in picturesque coastal fishing villages.
examples.zh: 劇組勘景團隊耗時兩個月在全台各地風景如畫的純樸沿海漁村間穿梭勘景物色場地。

examples.en: Thorough location scouting ensures that filming sites have accessible electricity, parking, and minimal ambient noise.
examples.zh: 實地嚴謹的實地場地勘景能確保拍攝場地擁有足夠電力供應、充足停車空間且遠離噪音干擾。

examples.en: He earned badges for outdoor survival skills during his years in boy scouting.
examples.zh: 在青少年時期參加童軍團露營活動的歲月裡，他考取了多枚野外求生技能榮譽布章。

words.definition: 拍板；場記板 (Slate)

examples.en: Snapping the clapperboard syncs recorded audio waveforms with camera video frames.
examples.zh: 在鏡頭前俐落敲響拍板（場記板）的清脆聲響能讓後期剪輯精準對齊音訊波形與畫面影格。

examples.en: The second assistant camera holds the clapperboard before the lens at the beginning of each take.
examples.zh: 攝影助理在每一個鏡頭（Take）正式開拍前，迅速將寫滿場次資訊的場記板舉至鏡頭前報幕打板。

examples.en: The clapperboard displays scene numbers, take counts, and director names clearly for the editing team.
examples.zh: 場記拍板上記錄著清楚明確的場次號碼、鏡次次數與導演姓名，便於後製剪輯團隊快速檢索。

words.definition: 正式主體的；主要的；本金

examples.en: Principal photography took forty intense shooting days across scenic locations in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 這部公路電影的正式主體拍攝階段（Principal Photography）歷經四十天馬不停蹄的環島取景。

examples.en: Once principal photography wrapped, the project shifted immediately to post-production and editing.
examples.zh: 正式主體拍攝階段圓滿殺青後，全片立刻進入緊鑼密鼓的後期剪輯與聲音調色階段。

examples.en: Making extra payments directly toward your loan principal reduces total mortgage interest over time.
examples.zh: 每月定期額外償還房貸借款本金，能在長遠看來大幅減少房貸利息支出總額。

words.definition: 全劇殺青；包裹；捲餅

examples.en: The director yelled 'That’s a wrap!' and the exhausted crew cheered in celebration.
examples.zh: 當導演在片場手持擴音器高喊「全劇殺青！」時，全體辛勞付出的劇組人員瞬間爆出歡呼。

examples.en: We hope to wrap today's intense filming schedule before sunset to avoid overtime penalties.
examples.zh: 我們希望能在夕陽西下天黑之前順利拍完今日密集的通告表，避免產生昂貴的超班加班費。

examples.en: She picked up a fresh chicken salad wrap from the convenience store for a quick lunch.
examples.zh: 她在超商隨手買了一份清爽低卡的現做雞肉沙拉捲餅，迅速解決忙碌工作間隙的午餐。

words.definition: 主光（影視打光核心光線）

examples.en: The gaffer positioned a warm key light to illuminate the actor's emotional eyes.
examples.zh: 燈光師巧妙在四十五度角架設了一盞溫柔的暖色調主光（Key Light），完美照亮演員眼眸中的淚光。

examples.en: Classical three-point film lighting utilizes a key light, a fill light, and a backlight.
examples.zh: 影視經典的三點打光法巧妙組合了主光、輔助補光燈（Fill Light）與勾勒輪廓的背光燈。

examples.en: Softening the key light with a large diffuser creates flattering, gentle skin tones on camera.
examples.zh: 在主光燈前加裝大型柔光布箱，能在高畫質攝影機前營造出細膩溫潤且討喜的皮膚質感。

words.definition: 錄音吊桿 (Boom Mic)；繁榮激增

examples.en: The sound engineer operated a carbon-fiber boom mic just outside the camera frame.
examples.zh: 現場收音師熟練高舉超長碳纖維錄音吊桿麥克風，精準懸停於攝影機畫面邊緣上方收音。

examples.en: The boom operator must have exceptional shoulder strength to hold the microphone steady for long takes.
examples.zh: 吊桿麥克風操作員必須具備驚人的肩臂肌耐力，才能在長鏡頭一鏡到底時全程穩如泰山。

examples.en: Taiwan's semiconductor industry experienced an unprecedented global export boom in recent years.
examples.zh: 台灣高階半導體晶圓代工與先進封裝產業在近年迎來了前所未有的全球外銷出口繁榮大爆發。

words.definition: 擬音後製藝術 (Foley)

examples.en: Foley artists crunched fresh celery stalks to recreate realistic footsteps in deep snow.
examples.zh: 專業擬音大師（Foley Artist）在隔音錄音室手捏新鮮西洋芹，逼真模擬雪地漫步的嘎吱踏雪聲。

examples.en: In an acoustically isolated studio, Foley technicians record subtle cloth swishes and door squeaks.
examples.zh: 在專業無回音隔音室內，擬音團隊精準錄製演員衣物摩擦窸窣聲與木門鉸鏈吱嘎聲等微小細節。

examples.en: Without Foley sound effects, modern action blockbusters would feel strangely hollow and unnatural.
examples.zh: 倘若沒有細膩真實的擬音後製音效輔佐，現代動作大片將會顯得莫名空洞且極度不自然。

words.definition: 蒙太奇剪接；快速組合畫面

examples.en: A dynamic training montage showed the boxer improving endurance over five years.
examples.zh: 一段節奏明快、熱血澎湃的五分鐘蒙太奇剪接快速呈現了拳擊手歷經五年苦練蛻變的歷程。

examples.en: The romantic drama opened with a nostalgic montage of vintage photographs and nostalgic home videos.
examples.zh: 這部唯美文藝愛情片以一段穿插老舊泛黃黑白照片與復古家庭錄影帶的懷舊蒙太奇開場。

examples.en: Using cross-cutting and montage compresses months of narrative story time into two thrilling minutes.
examples.zh: 善用交叉剪輯與蒙太奇手法，能將數個月漫長的故事劇情推進濃縮在短短兩分鐘的快節奏畫面中。

words.definition: 粗剪初版影片

examples.en: The director reviewed the three-hour rough cut to trim unnecessary conversational scenes.
examples.zh: 導演與剪接師閉門通宵檢視長達三小時的粗剪初版影片，果斷去蕪存菁剪除冗長的對白場景。

examples.en: Screening the early rough cut allowed the creative team to identify pacing flaws in the second act.
examples.zh: 內部秘密試映初步粗剪版本，讓主創團隊得以提早察覺電影第二幕節奏拖沓沉悶的敘事盲點。

examples.en: Color grading and final sound mixing only begin once the rough cut reaches locked picture status.
examples.zh: 唯有在粗剪初版定剪（Picture Lock）不再更動畫面影格之後，調色與終混才能正式啟動。

words.definition: 電影調色師；色彩專家

examples.en: The master colorist graded the cyberpunk film with neon magenta and cyan highlights.
examples.zh: 資深電影調色師運用 DaVinci Resolve 為整部賽博龐克科幻大片渲染上標誌性的霓虹紫紅與青藍色調。

examples.en: A skilled colorist balances skin tones while giving the scene a chilly, melancholic atmosphere.
examples.zh: 一位頂級調色師能在精準校正演員自然膚色的同時，賦予整場夜戲清冷肅穆的憂鬱氛圍感。

examples.en: Using color-calibrated reference monitors ensures that the colorist achieves flawless visual consistency.
examples.zh: 在經過嚴苛色彩校正的專業調色參考螢幕前作業，能確保調色師輸出毫無色差的極致統一畫面。

words.definition: 視覺特效 (Visual Effects)

examples.en: CGI creature modeling and pyrotechnic VFX seamlessly blended with practical stunt footage.
examples.zh: 電腦成像（CGI）神話怪獸模型與爆破視覺特效（VFX）與現場真實特技畫面完美融為一體。

examples.en: Over two thousand digital artists worked tirelessly to deliver the complex sci-fi VFX shots.
examples.zh: 超過兩千名全球頂尖數位特效藝術家夜以繼日趕工，才如期完成了這部科幻巨作中繁複的特效鏡頭。

examples.en: The film won the Academy Award for Best Visual Effects due to its photorealistic ocean simulations.
examples.zh: 這部史詩冒險大片憑藉幾可亂真、宛如實拍的擬真流體海洋模擬技術，勇奪奧斯卡最佳視覺效果獎。

words.definition: 動作捕捉技術 (Motion Capture)

examples.en: Actors wore sensor-covered suits for real-time facial and motion capture (mocap).
examples.zh: 演員們身穿貼滿反射感測點的緊身動作捕捉服，進行高難度即時面部表情與肢體動作捕捉。

examples.en: Mocap technology enables digital alien creatures to display authentic human emotional nuances.
examples.zh: 動態捕捉技術（Mocap）讓電腦生成的虛擬外星生物也能呈現出人類真情流露的細膩微表情。

examples.en: Video game studios rely heavily on mocap to animate realistic martial arts and athletic movement.
examples.zh: 現代 3A 遊戲大廠極度仰賴動態捕捉技術，以將真人武術特技與極限運動動作原汁原味數位化。

words.definition: 電影配樂大師；作曲家

examples.en: The acclaimed composer created a sweeping orchestral soundtrack that moved audiences.
examples.zh: 榮獲多座國際大獎的電影配樂大師譜寫出氣勢恢宏的交響樂原聲配樂，深深觸動了全場觀眾。

examples.en: Film director Christopher Nolan collaborated closely with composer Hans Zimmer on mind-bending scores.
examples.zh: 名導克里斯多福諾蘭與配樂巨擘漢斯季默深度合作，打造出多部震撼寰宇、顛覆感官的經典神曲。

examples.en: The versatile composer blended traditional Taiwanese folk instruments with modern electronic synthesizers.
examples.zh: 這位才華洋溢的配樂作曲大師巧妙將台灣傳統北管嗩吶等民俗樂器，與前衛現代電子合成器完美揉合。

words.definition: 影視語音配音；配音錄製

examples.en: Animated blockbusters release both original voice tracks and local Mandarin dubbing.
examples.zh: 好萊塢院線動畫大片在全台上映時，同步推出英語原音版本與笑點滿滿的國語配音版本。

examples.en: Skilled voice actors match their vocal dubbing precisely to foreign lip movements.
examples.zh: 實力深厚的資深配音員在配音錄製時，能將在地語言的語速與原片外語唇形精準分秒貼合。

examples.en: Some purist cinephiles prefer subtitles over dubbing to hear the raw emotional cadence of original actors.
examples.zh: 某些原汁原味死忠影迷堅持看原音搭中文字幕而非配音版，以完整聆聽原片演員的情感起伏與聲線。

words.definition: 影視中英文字幕；加字幕

examples.en: Bilingual subtitles allow global audiences to appreciate foreign language arthouse cinema.
examples.zh: 雙語字幕能讓全球跨國觀眾毫無語言隔閡地細細品味各國獨立外語藝術電影的深邃內涵。

examples.en: The film distribution company hired experienced translators to subtitle the dialect comedy into English.
examples.zh: 電影發行商重金禮聘深諳在地流行語的資深專業譯者，將方言喜劇精心翻譯製作成道地英文字幕。

examples.en: Turn on closed subtitles so elderly viewers can follow fast dialogue without missing key plot clues.
examples.zh: 開啟無障礙中文字幕能讓家中長輩輕鬆掌握連珠炮般的快嘴對白，絕不漏掉任何關鍵劇情線索。

words.definition: 國際影展；節慶慶典

examples.en: The Golden Horse Film Festival showcases cutting-edge contemporary Chinese-language cinema.
examples.zh: 台北金馬影展是華語影壇歷史最悠久、最具前瞻性與國際影響力的頂級當代電影盛會。

examples.en: Submitting their debut feature film to independent film festivals opens doors for young creators.
examples.zh: 將導演處女長片投件至各大國際獨立影展競賽，是青年新銳創作者叩關國際影壇的重要敲門磚。

examples.en: Thousands of passionate film buffs flock to movie theaters all day during the annual film festival.
examples.zh: 每年國際影展期間，全台數萬名熱血文青影迷起個大早穿梭於各大戲院間展開馬拉松式狂熱趕場。

words.definition: 大獎入圍者；獲提名者

examples.en: All five Best Director nominees gathered onstage to celebrate creative artistic courage.
examples.zh: 入圍金馬獎最佳導演獎的五位優秀電影導演齊聚榮耀舞台，共同舉杯慶祝無畏的創作勇氣。

examples.en: Being named an Oscar nominee instantly boosts an actor's international profile and career prospects.
examples.zh: 榮獲奧斯卡金像獎提名入圍者殊榮，能瞬間讓演員的國際知名度與未來的片約片酬身價水漲船高。

examples.en: The award ceremony cameras captured the anxious expressions of every Best Actor nominee.
examples.zh: 頒獎典禮現場導播鏡頭在揭曉得主瞬間，即時捕捉每位最佳男主角入圍者屏氣凝神的緊張神情。

words.definition: 獎座；雕像；塑像

examples.en: Holding the heavy bronze Golden Horse statue, the director delivered a tearful speech.
examples.zh: 雙手緊握沉甸甸的青銅金馬獎座，新銳導演在領獎台上發表了真情流露、感人肺腑的得獎感言。

examples.en: Tourists gathered to take commemorative photographs in front of the historic bronze statue downtown.
examples.zh: 來自世界各地的觀光客紛紛駐足於市中心歷史悠久的青銅偉人雕像前合影留念。

examples.en: Winning the iconic golden statue represents the pinnacle of recognition in the cinematic world.
examples.zh: 能夠在國際影壇殿堂捧起這尊標誌性的鍍金榮耀小金人獎座，象徵著電影人終其一生的最高肯定。

words.definition: 影展評審團；陪審團

examples.en: The grand jury deliberated intensely for seven hours before crowning the Best Picture.
examples.zh: 影展國際大評審團閉門激辯長達七個小時，最終以全票一致通過選出本屆最佳劇情長片得主。

examples.en: Serving as jury president at an international film festival requires profound cinematic literacy.
examples.zh: 獲邀擔任國際頂級電影節主競賽單元評審團主席，需要擁有極其深厚淵博的電影美學素養與鑑賞力。

examples.en: The court jury reached a unanimous verdict of innocent after examining all presented forensic evidence.
examples.zh: 法庭陪審團在仔細審閱檢辯雙方呈堂的所有法醫法證鐵證後，最終達成全票一致無罪裁決。

words.definition: 星光大道紅地毯；隆重禮遇

examples.en: Dazzling stars in bespoke haute couture gowns walked down the glamorous red carpet.
examples.zh: 眾多國際巨星身著量身訂製的高級訂製禮服優雅漫步於星光熠熠的頒獎典禮紅地毯。

examples.en: Screaming fans lined both sides of the red carpet barrier hoping for autographs and selfies.
examples.zh: 狂熱尖叫的死忠影迷早早卡位擠滿了星光大道紅毯護欄兩側，爭睹偶像風采並索取簽名合影。

examples.en: The visiting foreign dignitaries received a full red carpet welcome at the presidential office.
examples.zh: 蒞臨來訪的友邦國家元首與外賓特使團，在總統府前廣場受到了最高規格的鋪紅毯隆重軍禮禮遇。

words.definition: 電影全球首映會；初次上映

examples.en: The film made its world premiere at the prestigious Venice International Film Festival.
examples.zh: 這部震撼人心的歷史史詩巨作於享負盛名的義大利威尼斯國際影展進行了隆重的全球首映。

examples.en: Tickets for the midnight premiere screening sold out completely within forty seconds of opening.
examples.zh: 這部超級大片的午夜首映場電影票在開賣系統剛上線四十秒內，便全數被瘋搶一空。

examples.en: The highly anticipated sci-fi sequel is scheduled to premiere in theaters worldwide next December.
examples.zh: 這部備受全球影迷引頸期盼的科幻史詩續集電影，已正式定檔於明年十二月全球院線盛大首映。

words.definition: 院線商業超級大片；暢銷鉅作

examples.en: Summer superhero blockbusters generate billions of dollars in global box office receipts.
examples.zh: 每年盛夏強檔推出的超級英雄商業超級大片（Blockbuster）在全美與全球席捲數十億美元票房。

examples.en: Film studios invest heavily in marketing campaigns to ensure the blockbuster dominates opening weekend.
examples.zh: 好萊塢八大片商不惜砸下數千萬美元鋪天蓋地宣傳，誓要確保商業巨片在首映週末強勢稱霸榜首。

examples.en: Beyond commercial blockbusters, thoughtful viewers appreciate slow-paced arthouse character studies.
examples.zh: 在刺激爽快的商業大片之外，有深度品味的資深影迷同樣懂得細細咀嚼慢節奏的文藝角色探討佳作。

words.definition: 電影票房紀錄；售票處

examples.en: The inspiring local sports drama broke domestic box office records within two weeks.
examples.zh: 這部勵志熱血的本土棒球傳奇電影在上映短短兩週內便勢如破竹打破全台本土電影票房紀錄。

examples.en: High box office earnings do not always correlate with positive artistic reviews from critics.
examples.zh: 一部電影在商業上狂攬的亮眼票房數字，並不必然等同於能收穫專業影評界同等高度的藝術評價。

examples.en: You can pick up your reserved cinema tickets directly at the automatic box office kiosk.
examples.zh: 你可以直接在電影院大廳擺設的自動售票機（Box Office Kiosk）掃描 QR Code 領取預售票。

words.definition: 獨立製片的；獨立電影 (Independent)

examples.en: Low-budget indie films often explore bold, controversial social themes ignored by studios.
examples.zh: 小成本低預算的獨立製片電影往往敢於觸及主流大片不敢涉足的深刻邊緣社會議題。

examples.en: Many renowned directors launched their visionary careers by shooting gritty indie movies on tiny budgets.
examples.zh: 許多當代揚名立萬的大導演最初皆是靠著極其有限的微薄預算，克難拍出震撼人心的獨立神作起家。

examples.en: Indie record labels champion underground musicians who create experimental sonic landscapes.
examples.zh: 獨立音樂廠牌始終熱情支持地下獨立音樂人，讓他們能不受商業拘束盡情開拓前衛實驗聲響。

words.definition: 藝術電影的；光點藝術戲院

examples.en: Art-house cinemas screen European retrospectives and classic restored 35mm masterworks.
examples.zh: 台北光點等獨立藝術電影戲院定期策劃歐洲大師回顧展並放映珍貴的 35 毫米經典膠卷修復片。

examples.en: Cinephiles gather at intimate art-house venues to engage in deep post-screening philosophical Q&A discussions.
examples.zh: 熱愛深度思考的文青影迷聚集在溫馨迷人的光點藝術戲院，在映後講座中與導演展開哲學辯證。

examples.en: Financing an art-house production relies heavily on government cultural grants and co-production funds.
examples.zh: 籌拍一部小眾深刻的純藝術長片，極度仰賴各國文化部的影視輔導金與國際跨國合拍基金資助。

words.definition: 紀實紀錄片；紀實的

examples.en: The award-winning environmental documentary exposed illegal industrial ocean dumping.
examples.zh: 這部榮獲多座國際環保大獎的深度調查紀實紀錄片，勇敢揭露了不肖工廠偷排有毒廢水的真相。

examples.en: Watching a powerful investigative documentary altered her consumer choices regarding plastic packaging.
examples.zh: 觀看了一部震撼人心的深度調查紀錄片之後，徹底翻轉改變了她在日常生活中對塑膠包裝的消費選擇。

examples.en: The filmmaker spent seven years shooting documentary footage of migrating birds along the coast.
examples.zh: 這位紀錄片導演耗費了整整七年漫長歲月，沿著西海岸濕地實地蹲點跟拍珍稀候鳥遷徙的珍貴生態鏡頭。

words.definition: 電影類型；文學藝術體裁

examples.en: Horror, psychological thrillers, and romantic comedies are enduring cinematic genres.
examples.zh: 心理驚悚片、超自然恐怖片與浪漫愛情喜劇是深受各年齡層影迷喜愛且歷久不衰的電影類型。

examples.en: The innovative director blended elements of sci-fi and historical drama to create a fresh hybrid genre.
examples.zh: 這位大膽創新的鬼才導演巧妙將未來科幻與真實歷史宮廷劇元素熔於一爐，開創出嶄新的跨界類型。

examples.en: Knowing your preferred literary genre makes selecting your next weekend book much easier.
examples.zh: 清楚掌握自己平日最偏愛的小說閱讀類型，能讓你在實體書店挑選週末讀物時更加省時精準。

words.definition: 浪漫愛情喜劇片 (Romantic Comedy)

examples.en: Cozy up on a rainy weekend to enjoy a lighthearted, witty holiday rom-com.
examples.zh: 在陰雨連綿的週末窩在溫暖沙發上，欣賞一部節奏明快、笑料不斷的經典浪漫愛情喜劇（Rom-com）。

examples.en: The classic enemies-to-lovers trope is a beloved hallmark of memorable 1990s rom-coms.
examples.zh: 從一開始針鋒相對的歡喜冤家逐漸擦出愛火的經典設定，是九零年代浪漫愛情喜劇片最招牌的迷人套路。

examples.en: Laughing and crying along with a charming rom-com is the perfect way to decompress after work.
examples.zh: 隨著一部節奏溫馨動人的愛情喜劇笑中帶淚，是洗滌一整天疲憊不堪工作壓力的最療癒良方。

words.definition: 特技動作；驚人絕技；特技替身

examples.en: Brave professional stunt doubles perform dangerous high-speed car flips and fiery explosions.
examples.zh: 勇敢無畏的專業特技替身演員在片場親自上陣完成高難度的極速飛車翻滾與爆破跳樓動作。

examples.en: The Hollywood action star is famous for doing all his own thrilling rooftop climbing stunts.
examples.zh: 這位好萊塢當紅動作硬漢巨星以堅持拒絕替身、親自上陣完成所有驚心動魄的徒手攀爬摩天大樓特技聞名。

examples.en: Pulling off such an audacious aerial stunt required months of calculations and safety rigging.
examples.zh: 想要在空中完美無瑕地執行如此危險大膽的高空特技跳躍，需要經歷數月精密的物理測算與威亞防護。

words.definition: 武術動作指導；編舞

examples.en: Martial arts fight choreography required three months of rigorous weapon rehearsal.
examples.zh: 該部武俠史詩大片的武術動作指導與兵器套路設計耗時三個月的高強度封閉式實戰排練。

examples.en: The fluid dance choreography in the musical film synchronized flawlessly with the brass melody.
examples.zh: 這部歌舞大片中行雲流水般的曼妙群舞編排，與背景音樂中熱情激昂的銅管旋律達成了天衣無縫的契合。

examples.en: Hong Kong cinema pioneered intricate swordfight choreography that influenced action movies worldwide.
examples.zh: 八九零年代傳統香港功夫電影所開創的精妙套招過招打鬥動作設計，深遠影響了全球動作大片的運鏡理念。

words.definition: 懸疑張力；懸念懸疑感

examples.en: Alfred Hitchcock is universally revered as the master of building spine-chilling suspense.
examples.zh: 驚悚大師希區考克被全球影壇公認為掌控心理節奏、營造令人屏息窒息懸疑張力的至高大師。

examples.en: The ticking clock in the soundtrack raised the suspense until the detective solved the bomb puzzle.
examples.zh: 背景配樂中不斷倒數計時的滴答聲將全場懸疑張力拉升到最高點，直到警探在最後一秒拆除炸彈。

examples.en: Don't keep us in suspense—tell us right now who won the election!
examples.zh: 別再吊我們的胃口賣關子了——趕快直接告訴我們究竟是誰贏得了這場激烈的選舉！

words.definition: 獨白；內心獨白；長篇獨角戲

examples.en: The protagonist delivered an unforgettable five-minute courtroom dramatic monologue.
examples.zh: 男主角在法庭審判高潮戲份中，發表了一段長達五分鐘、一氣呵成令人震撼的深情戲劇獨白。

examples.en: Auditioning actors must prepare both a dramatic monologue and a comedic monologue.
examples.zh: 參加專業劇團試鏡遴選的演員，通常必須自備一段深沉的正劇獨白與一段風趣幽默的喜劇獨白。

examples.en: Her intense internal monologue revealed psychological conflicts that dialogue alone could not convey.
examples.zh: 她內心翻江倒海的深刻心靈內心獨白，精準揭示了單憑日常口頭對白所無法全然表達的複雜人性糾葛。

words.definition: 潛台詞；弦外之音；話中有話

examples.en: Brilliant screenwriting conveys emotional heartbreak through subtle dialogue subtext.
examples.zh: 真正上乘絕妙的劇本台詞懂得透過微言大義的潛台詞，在平淡對白背後傳遞排山倒海的心碎。

examples.en: Although the estranged couple discussed trivial weather topics, the underlying emotional subtext was pure grief.
examples.zh: 儘管這對形同陌路的夫妻表面上只是言不及義地寒暄著天氣瑣事，但言談間流淌的潛台詞卻滿溢悲傷。

examples.en: Great actors communicate subtext through slight pauses, eye movements, and body posture.
examples.zh: 殿堂級演技大師懂得透過意味深長的微小停頓、眼神流轉與微妙肢體語言，精準向觀眾傳達弦外之音。

words.definition: 視覺隱喻；隱喻象徵

examples.en: The recurring birdcage served as a poignant visual metaphor for emotional entrapment.
examples.zh: 影片中反覆出現的精緻金屬鳥籠，被導演巧妙運用為女主角內心渴望自由的深刻視覺隱喻。

examples.en: Poets frequently utilize the changing seasons as a metaphor for the human cycle of life and aging.
examples.zh: 詩人往往習慣將春夏秋冬的四季遞嬗，借代作為人生生老病死與歲月興衰的深刻隱喻。

examples.en: The filmmaker explained that the flooded city streets were an intentional metaphor for societal breakdown.
examples.zh: 導演在訪談中深入剖析，片中被滾滾洪流淹沒的末日都市街景，實則是整個文明體系崩解的鮮活隱喻。

words.definition: 象徵手法；象徵主義

examples.en: Heavy pouring rain reflects the internal grief and emotional cleansing of characters.
examples.zh: 窗外瓢潑傾盆的大雨運用了經典的象徵主義手法，映照出劇中角色內心的悲痛與最終救贖。

examples.en: The film employs rich religious and botanical symbolism to explore themes of sacrifice and rebirth.
examples.zh: 該片大膽運用了大量繁複且深邃的宗教符號與草木植被象徵，以深度探討自我犧牲與靈魂重生的宏大主題。

examples.en: Literary analysts unpack the profound moral symbolism hidden within the classic novel.
examples.zh: 文學評論家在一篇篇深刻的長篇論文中，層層剖析解讀隱藏在部傳世經典名著文字背後的深邃道德象徵。

words.definition: 大特寫鏡頭；近景拍攝

examples.en: An extreme close-up of trembling hands revealed the detective's hidden terror.
examples.zh: 導演突然切入一個警探雙手微顫的極限大特寫鏡頭，無聲揭示了其內心深處隱藏的極度恐懼。

examples.en: The director cut directly from a wide landscape shot to a tearful close-up of the mother's face.
examples.zh: 剪接師由開闊遼闊的群山大遠景突然俐落跳剪至母親眼角含淚的臉部大特寫，戲劇張力瞬間爆棚。

examples.en: In cinematic storytelling, an intimate close-up draws the viewer directly into a character's vulnerability.
examples.zh: 在視聽語言敘事藝術中，一個直指人心的親密大特寫鏡頭能將觀眾的心瞬間拉入角色的脆弱防線之中。

words.definition: 水平搖鏡；全景掃描運鏡

examples.en: Smooth horizontal camera panning introduced the bustling evening temple market.
examples.zh: 攝影機鏡頭由左至右進行平穩流暢的水平搖鏡運鏡，將熱鬧喧囂的廟埕夜市全景盡收眼底。

examples.en: The camera panning revealed the vast expanse of the desert stretching toward the horizon.
examples.zh: 流暢平移的水平搖鏡運鏡將一望無際、綿延至天際線盡頭的荒涼大沙漠全景壯麗呈現在觀眾眼前。

examples.en: Rapid whip panning between speakers creates an energetic, comic book-like momentum in action scenes.
examples.zh: 在激烈的警匪對峙場面中，攝影師在不同對峙角色之間使用極速甩鏡（Whip Panning），營造出如美漫般的強烈動能。

words.definition: 影音線上串流平台；串流播放

examples.en: Video streaming platforms have made global international cinema accessible to living rooms.
examples.zh: 現代智慧電視與線上影音串流平台打破國界藩籬，讓全球頂級電影隨時隨地在客廳客製放映。

examples.en: High-speed fiber internet enables uninterrupted 4K video streaming with zero buffering.
examples.zh: 高速光纖寬頻網路普及讓超高畫質 4K 影音線上串流播放順暢無阻，徹底告別轉圈圈卡頓延遲。

examples.en: The rise of digital streaming has fundamentally changed how television studios greenlight new shows.
examples.zh: 數位線上影音串流經濟的強勢崛起，從根本上顛覆改寫了各大電視台與好萊塢片廠投資立項影視劇的決策思維。

words.definition: 馬拉松式連續追劇；一口氣刷劇

examples.en: Fans binge-watched all eight thrilling episodes of the mystery series in one night.
examples.zh: 熱血影迷在週五深夜一口氣通宵連看八集，完成了一場欲罷不能的懸疑台劇馬拉松式追劇。

examples.en: When holiday breaks arrive, people love to binge-watch entire seasons of their favorite sitcoms.
examples.zh: 每逢連假春節假期到來，窩在沙發上一口氣刷完整季最心愛的經典情境喜劇是無數劇迷的快樂泉源。

examples.en: Streaming networks release all episodes at once to satisfy viewers who prefer to binge-watch over a weekend.
examples.zh: 串流影音巨頭選擇在週五將整季影集所有集數一次性全數上線，以充分迎合現代劇迷週末熬夜連環追劇的偏好。

words.definition: 全場起立熱烈鼓掌 (Standing Ovation)

examples.en: The credits rolled and the Cannes audience erupted into a ten-minute standing ovation.
examples.zh: 當片尾字幕緩緩升起，坎城影展全場千名觀眾不約而同起立致敬，爆出長達十分鐘的熱烈鼓掌。

examples.en: The soloist bowed humbly as the symphony hall gave her an emotional standing ovation.
examples.zh: 當整座國家音樂廳所有觀眾起立爆出震耳欲聾的激動鼓掌喝采時，舞台中央的鋼琴獨奏家深深謙遜鞠躬。

examples.en: Receiving a spontaneous standing ovation from peers is the ultimate tribute for an artist.
examples.zh: 在頒獎典禮現場收穫全場所有同行發自內心自發起立的熱烈鼓掌致敬，是身為藝術家終其一生的至高榮耀。

words.definition: 老電影數位修復；修復重建

examples.en: The Taiwan Film and Audiovisual Institute completed 4K digital restoration of classic Taiwanese-language films.
examples.zh: 國家電影及視聽文化中心戮力完成了數十部珍貴台語經典黑白老電影的 4K 數位修復保存工程。

examples.en: Film restoration involves digitally cleaning dust scratches, stabilizing color fade, and remastering optical audio.
examples.zh: 老電影數位修復是一門兼具科技與匠心的浩大工程，涵蓋逐格數位除塵刮痕修補、色彩校正與老光學音軌重製。

examples.en: Preserving cinematic cultural heritage through meticulous digital restoration ensures that masterpieces inspire future generations.
examples.zh: 透過無微不至的數位修復悉心保存無價的電影文化資產，能確保這些影壇傳世瑰寶持續啟迪未來世代的創作者。
